title: Hysteresis bypasses MaxRankIncrease protection
description: The hysteresis logic fetches 'current' from self.parents (line 258), not from the 'admissible' list (line 243). If the current preferred parent becomes non-admissible (path cost exceeds _lowest_rank + max_rank_increase), the hysteresis check on lines 262-264 can still select them when improvement < threshold. This violates RFC 6550 MaxRankIncrease constraint, risking routing loops. Fix: check 'if current is not None and self._admissible(current) and current.neighbor_id != best.neighbor_id'.
close_reason: Fixed: Added _admissible(current) check to hysteresis condition (line 259). This ensures a non-admissible current parent cannot be retained via hysteresis, enforcing RFC 6550 MaxRankIncrease constraint.
